steps.say: Students join with this link — share it and they sign up straight into this class.
Prefer a whiteboard? **Show code instead** reveals a standing code — anyone who enters it at saysomethingin.com/redeem joins this class, until the code changes.
**Play as class** is the heart of it: one device — yours — leads the whole class through a session, and it counts for every student on the roster.
steps.terminal: When you're ready, tap Play as class for real — this tour never starts a session for you.
